# Hush Hush

> A standalone secrets object store: a writer only ever needs the service's
> public key to add or rotate a value, and a consumer only ever needs an
> object id to fetch it. Public-key encryption (age) end to end - the
> server stores and serves sealed ciphertext and never computes or returns
> plaintext.

v1's read path is deliberately flat: fetching an object's ciphertext needs
no authorization, only its id. The confidentiality boundary is entirely
"who holds a matching private key" - every fetch is recorded to the audit
log instead. Writes (create, update, delete) are gated by a bearer token.
`POST /mcp` serves the same five operations over the Model Context
Protocol's Streamable HTTP transport, for an agent that needs to read or
write a secret as one step in a larger task.

This file covers `/docs/api/` - the rendered API reference - not the rest
of the `alrayyes/Hush-Hush` repo or its web UI.

## Docs

- [API reference](https://alrayyes.github.io/Hush-Hush/docs/api/): the
  Stoplight Elements rendering of the OpenAPI contract below - browsable
  endpoint list, request/response schemas, and examples.
- [OpenAPI spec](https://alrayyes.github.io/Hush-Hush/api/openapi.yaml): the
  machine-readable contract itself - endpoints, schemas, and auth
  requirements for `objects`, `audit-log`, `consumers`, `auth`,
  `credentials`, `tokens`, and `mcp`.
- [README](https://github.com/alrayyes/Hush-Hush/blob/main/README.md):
  install, configuration, Docker usage, and the MCP/web-UI setup this API
  sits behind.
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/alrayyes/Hush-Hush/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md):
  the encryption model, read-path and write-path auth, and storage backend
  behind this API's design.

## SDKs

- [hush-hush-go](https://github.com/alrayyes/hush-hush-go): typed Go client
  generated from this API's OpenAPI spec.
- [hush-hush-python](https://github.com/alrayyes/hush-hush-python): the same,
  generated for Python.
- [hush-hush-node](https://github.com/alrayyes/hush-hush-node): the same,
  generated for Node.js/TypeScript.
- [hush-hush-php](https://github.com/alrayyes/hush-hush-php): the same,
  generated for PHP.
- [hush-hush-cli](https://github.com/alrayyes/hush-hush-cli): the
  command-line client (`inject`, `get`, `update`, `delete`) built on this
  API.
